correctness.rationale: The graph is fixed as twelve ordered pairs and eighteen edges; each of all 3^12 colorings is evaluated exactly once in two independent encodings. Both yield all 13 sector minima and multiplicities; an integer hull comparison proves the minimum of five affine functions for every real field and calculates every critical degeneracy. The executable proof is finite and exhaustive, not empirical sampling or an extrapolation.

value.rationale: A full color-selective zero-temperature magnetization and degeneracy classification on a standard twelve-site Archimedean antiferromagnetic cluster, resolving four field-induced coexistence events and their exact entropies, is a motivated natural finite observable. This is more specific than, and not implied by, the zero-field 3-colorability count. It is a reproducible benchmark for low-temperature finite-cluster physics without asserting macroscopic phase transitions.
